registrations.presentation: 20g/100mL (equivalent to L-alanine 8.2 g, L-glutamine 13.46 g per 100 mL) Concentrate for Solution for IV Infusion
registrations.packaging: Hydrolytic Resistance Type II, colourless glass bottle x 100 mL (Box of 10's)

summary: Dipeptiven (Fresenius Kabi Austria GmbH) is a concentrated N(2)-L-alanyl-L-glutamine solution, a glutamine dipeptide added to parenteral or enteral nutrition in hypercatabolic or hypermetabolic states. Philippine registration: 100 ml glass bottles.
composition_notes: Theoretical osmolarity 921 mOsmol/l; pH 5.4 to 6.0 (SmPC). These amounts match the Philippine registration (20 g/100 ml, equivalent to L-alanine 8.2 g and L-glutamine 13.46 g).
dosing_limits: 0.3 to 0.5 g alanyl-glutamine/kg body weight per day (1.5 to 2.5 ml/kg); maximum 2.5 ml/kg/day; must not exceed 30% of total amino acid/protein supply; not more than 3 weeks (SmPC 4.2).
kidney_notes: Contraindicated in severe renal insufficiency (creatinine clearance below 25 ml/min), severe hepatic insufficiency, circulatory shock, hypoxia, multiple organ failure and severe metabolic acidosis (SmPC 4.3).
Monitor serum electrolytes, serum osmolality, fluid balance, acid-base balance, creatinine clearance, urea and liver function tests (SmPC 4.4).
guideline_heading: How it fits the ESPEN 2021 kidney nutrition guideline
guideline: ESPEN 2021 Recommendation 28: "In critically ill patients with AKI, AKI on CKD, or CKD with KF, additional high dose parenteral glutamine shall not be administered." Grade of recommendation A – Strong consensus (100% agreement).
bottom_line: Do not use in critically ill patients with AKI (acute kidney injury), AKI on CKD (chronic kidney disease) or CKD with kidney failure (ESPEN Rec 28, Grade A); outside critical illness, the SmPC contraindicates it when creatinine clearance is below 25 ml/min.
withheld: The Philippine package insert was not available to compare; check it before use.
